description: Is a date a business day? Answers for one or several calendars at once and says why not (holiday name, weekend) or flags a half day / early close. calendars: one or more calendar codes from list_calendars, e.g. ["USD.FX", "EUR.FX"] for a EUR/USD FX trade, ["XNYS.SETTLE"] for NYSE settlement, ["TARGET2.PAY"] for euro payments, ["GBLON.BANK"] for London banks. A date counts as a business day only when it is open in every calendar given. date defaults to today (yyyy-mm-dd).
name: is_business_day
title: Is it a business day?
